name: Nitta Shigeru
source:
He has worked as a producer many times before. He is well trusted by the field, the company, and sponsors.

He is considered a soft-spoken and gentle man, He is called “Shige-chan”, and many people look up to him.

In reality, however, he is a black-hearted man with a dark desire to turn newcomers and idols into his favorite slaves.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/housoukinshi/index.html]official site[/url]]
